title: Pohang Canal Dataset: A Multimodal Maritime Dataset for Autonomous Navigation in Restricted Waters
summary: Multimodal maritime dataset from a 7.5 km route through a narrow canal, port areas and near-coast waters, with LiDARs, marine radar, stereo, infrared and omnidirectional cameras, AHRS and RTK GPS. Also on the AWS Open Data registry.
key_takeaways: Includes marine radar and LiDAR together - good for radar odometry at sea
RTK ground truth and SLAM baseline trajectory included
CC BY-NC 4.0 - non-commercial use only

title: PoLaRIS Dataset: A Maritime Object Detection and Tracking Dataset in Pohang Canal
summary: Inha University dataset that adds object detection and tracking labels to five Pohang Canal sequences, with annotations on RGB, thermal, LiDAR and radar data for objects as small as 10x10 pixels. No separate licence stated; the underlying Pohang Canal data is CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial).
key_takeaways: Adds object labels to the Pohang Canal setting
Multi-modal labels for camera, thermal, LiDAR and radar detection on USVs
Inherits the non-commercial terms of the Pohang Canal data

title: MassMIND: Massachusetts Maritime INfrared Dataset
summary: Paper describing a labelled LWIR maritime dataset of 2,916 images from in and around Boston Harbor, segmented into seven classes, with UNet, PSPNet and DeepLabv3 baselines. Data is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial).
key_takeaways: Thermal segmentation for USV situational awareness
Semantic and instance masks provided
Non-commercial licence (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

title: LaRS: A Diverse Panoptic Maritime Obstacle Detection Dataset and Benchmark
summary: ICCV 2023 panoptic obstacle detection benchmark from lakes, rivers and seas: over 4,000 per-pixel labelled key frames, each with nine preceding frames (40k+ frames), 11 classes and an online evaluation server. CC BY-NC 4.0, research use only, download behind a registration form.
key_takeaways: Most diverse maritime obstacle set by location and conditions
Online server for objective scoring
Baselines for 27 segmentation methods
Non-commercial, research-only terms; no redistribution

title: SubPipe: A Submarine Pipeline Inspection Dataset for Segmentation and Visual-inertial Localization
summary: Describes an AUV dataset from a real pipeline inspection mission (OceanScan LAUV) with two cameras, side-scan sonar and navigation data, with SLAM, RGB segmentation and sonar object detection baselines. Data on Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 with a required copyright notice.
key_takeaways: Open underwater visual SLAM benchmark with pose ground truth from navigation sensors
Side-scan sonar object detection labels (COCO and YOLO); segmentation labels are on RGB

title: Caltech Aerial RGB-Thermal Dataset in the Wild
summary: Aerial RGB-thermal dataset over natural US terrain with synchronized GPS and IMU, with benchmarks for thermal segmentation, RGB-to-thermal translation and VIO.
key_takeaways: Thermal aerial data is expensive to collect - this fills a gap
Includes VIO benchmark with GPS/IMU
Dataset is for non-commercial use only (README: CC BY-SA 4.0 terms)

title: Cardinal RF (CardRF): An Outdoor UAV/UAS/Drone RF Signals with Bluetooth and WiFi Signals Dataset
summary: Outdoor RF dataset of drone controller and telemetry signals plus Bluetooth and Wi-Fi, stored as .mat files, covering line-of-sight and beyond-line-of-sight conditions.
key_takeaways: Many controllers from several manufacturers in 2.4 GHz
Includes Wi-Fi/Bluetooth confusers
Large download (tens of GB); MATLAB loader provided

title: DroneDetect Dataset: A Radio Frequency dataset of Unmanned Aerial System (UAS) Signals for Machine Learning Detection & Classification
summary: RF recordings of seven drones (six DJI models and the Parrot Disco) captured with a BladeRF SDR in GNU Radio, split by interference (clean, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, both) and flight mode (on, hovering, flying). CC BY licence, free IEEE login needed.
key_takeaways: Interference-labelled RF data for robust classifiers
Python loader splits recordings into short samples
Do not confuse with an unrelated image dataset of the same name

title: DIAT-uSAT: micro-Doppler Signature Dataset of Small Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (SUAV)
summary: 4,849 micro-Doppler signature images from an X-band (10 GHz) continuous-wave radar of small UAV-like targets: RC plane, two rotor types, quadcopter, bionic bird and mini-helicopter plus bionic bird.
key_takeaways: Radar micro-Doppler classification of drones vs birds
Access via e-mail request for education use

title: DroneRFb-Spectra: A RF spectrogram dataset for drone recognition
summary: 14,460 spectrograms (512x512, from 50 ms USRP IQ captures over three ISM bands in urban settings) of drone controllers from 7 brands, tied to an IEEE TIFS 2024 open-set drone recognition paper. CC BY licence.
key_takeaways: Ready-made spectrograms - no SDR processing needed
Covers 7 brands: DJI, Vbar, FrSky, Futaba, Taranis, RadioLink, Skydroid
Open-set recognition angle for unknown drones

title: Noisy Drone RF Signal Classification (Kaggle)
summary: Kaggle drone RF classification dataset: 1.2 ms IQ vectors from 6 consumer drone remotes plus a noise class, mixed with lab noise or Gaussian noise across SNR -20 to 30 dB. CC BY 4.0.
key_takeaways: SNR labels allow robustness curves
PyTorch tensor format

title: GNSS Interference Spectrum Highway Dataset 1
summary: 20 ms raw IQ snapshots (E1 and E6 bands, 62.5 MHz) from a sensor on a bridge over a German highway, labelled into 8 interference and 3 non-interference classes, in .npy format with train/test and few-shot splits.
key_takeaways: Real-world interference recorded at a highway
Non-commercial licence (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)
Companion dataset 2 has fewer classes (2 interference, 1 non-interference)

title: FGI Jammer Test 2023 Repository
summary: Open raw IQ recordings (GPS L1 C/A and Galileo E1, LabSat 3 Wideband) from Jammertest 2023 in Norway covering a high-power jamming case, incoherent spoofing and coherent spoofing scenarios, under CC BY 4.0.
key_takeaways: Real spoofing IQ data under open licence
Usable with FGI-GSRx software receiver

title: Raw IQ dataset for GNSS GPS jamming signal classification
summary: Raw IQ dataset of GNSS jamming signal types (DME, narrowband, single AM, single chirp, single FM, no jamming) with 1000 training and 250 test samples, generated with a MATLAB script built on the Morales Ferre et al. 2019 jammer-classification data. CC BY 4.0.
key_takeaways: Common benchmark for jamming-type classifiers
Converted to spectrogram images in follow-up work
Signals are generated in MATLAB, not live over-the-air captures

title: GNSS L1 Jammed Signal 10MHz Recording - Triangular Wave (Part 1)
summary: One of a series of February 2025 Zenodo records from LINKS Foundation with GNSS L1 IQ recordings at 10 and 20 MHz sample rates under several jamming waveforms (triangular, tick, linear narrow, linear wide fast) at stepped jamming powers. CC BY 4.0; Horizon Europe grant 101073909.
key_takeaways: More recent real IQ jamming captures
Each file is about 10 GB of int8 complex samples

title: UAV Acoustic Localization Dataset: 24-Channel Beamformed Recordings of a DJI Air 3 Drone with Synchronized GPS Flight Logs
summary: 24-channel acoustic recordings (48 kHz, four synced Zoom F6 recorders) of a DJI Air 3 drone with synchronized GPS flight logs at 100 ms, including no-drone ambient segments, under CC BY-SA 4.0.
key_takeaways: Ground-truth positions enable acoustic localization, not just detection
Multi-recorder synchronized array

title: UaVirBASE: A Public-Access Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Sound Source Localization Dataset
summary: Public dataset of synchronized multi-microphone UAV recordings under controlled distance, altitude, azimuth and orientation variations, for acoustic source localization.
key_takeaways: Controlled geometry for DOA algorithm testing

title: Improving Small Drone Detection Through Multi-Scale Processing and Data Augmentation
summary: Entry to the 8th WOSDETC Drone-vs-Bird challenge at IJCNN 2025 using multi-scale YOLOv11 inference and copy-paste augmentation for tiny drones.
key_takeaways: Multi-scale tiling is key for tiny targets
Copy-paste augmentation helps with scarce drone pixels
v1 abstract says top-3; v2 (Nov 2025) says first place

title: Kilometer-Scale GNSS-Denied UAV Navigation via Heightmap Gradients: A Winning System from the SPRIN-D Challenge
summary: Describes the winning SPRIN-D Fully Autonomous Flight system: LiDAR local heightmaps matched against prior elevation data by gradient templates, fused with odometry in a clustered particle filter, flying about 9 km below 25 m AGL without GNSS.
key_takeaways: Heightmap gradients avoid needing reliable absolute (barometric) height
Clustered particle filter handles multimodal position
Runs on CPU in real time
No public code found

title: SPRIND Fully Autonomous Flight challenge
authors: SPRIND (German Federal Agency for Breakthrough Innovation)
summary: German innovation agency challenge for long-range autonomous flight without GNSS; Fly4Future (CTU spin-off) won, with Beyond Vision and KopterKraft on the podium; a 2.0 edition followed.
key_takeaways: Real GNSS-denied long-range task specification
Winners published method details

title: Meet the 8th CASSINI Hackathon Winners (EU Space for Defence and Security)
summary: EUSPA announcement of the defence and security CASSINI hackathon winners, including SignalVoid (satellite-imagery geolocation for drones without GNSS) and SignalHawk (GNSS spoofing detection).
key_takeaways: Two of four winners tackled GNSS-free navigation or spoofing
Pitch videos linked

title: EUDIS Defence Hackathon Klagenfurt winners (Oct 2026)
summary: Report on the Klagenfurt site of the autumn 2026 EUDIS Defence Hackathon: IRNAS (Slovenia) won with multi-sensor fusion for ground robots; by the team's account path deviation fell from 37 cm to about 1 cm over 150+ test runs.
key_takeaways: Winning entry was ground-robot sensor fusion, not visual drone nav
No code repository linked

title: SoftServe engineers win TIDE NATO Hackathon 2023 challenge
summary: Coverage of the TIDE NATO Hackathon 2023 in Poland, whose three challenges included Small UAV Visual Navigation Concepts; SoftServe won the Analytics Dashboard for Interoperability challenge.
key_takeaways: NATO ACT has posed visual UAV navigation as a hackathon challenge
Challenge winners were due to present at the Spring 2023 TIDE Sprint in Norway

title: ION Smartphone Decimeter Challenge (with Google)
summary: ION page for the 3rd Smartphone Decimeter Challenge (Google, ION Satellite Division and Kaggle; ran Sep 12, 2023 - May 23, 2024). It lists Norizumi Motooka first, Taro Suzuki second and Jeonghyeon Yun third, with $7,000 / $5,000 / $3,000 prizes.
key_takeaways: Prize eligibility needs a technical paper and a talk at ION GNSS+ 2024, not just a Kaggle rank
Winners present at ION GNSS+

title: ACM MM 2023 Multimedia Drone Satellite Matching Challenge (UAVM 2023)
summary: Codalab leaderboard for drone-to-satellite matching on the University-160k extension.
key_takeaways: Recall@1 leaderboard
Several team codebases are public
Leaderboard is not the final ranking: the top entry (98.94) was removed for using University-1652 test data
University-1652 data is request-only: research use, no sharing with third parties, no profit (layumi/University1652-Baseline Request.md)

title: ACM MM 2024 Multi-weather Drone Satellite Matching Challenge (UAVM 2024)
summary: Codalab leaderboard for weather-robust drone-satellite matching.
key_takeaways: Adds weather corruptions to cross-view retrieval
University-1652 data is request-only: research use, no sharing with third parties, no profit (layumi/University1652-Baseline Request.md)

title: ACM MM 2026 Workshop on UAVs (UAVM 2026)
summary: Workshop and challenge site for the 4th UAVs in Multimedia workshop at ACM MM 2026. The challenge (29 Mar - 30 Jun 2026, on Codabench) uses the PairUAV dataset for last-meter relative pose alignment; workshop on 14 Nov 2026.
key_takeaways: Challenge shifts from retrieval to precise approach navigation
Awards require open-source code
PairUAV derives from University-1652, which is request-only for research use with no third-party sharing or profit

title: Last-Meter Precision Navigation for UAVs: A Diffusion-Refined Aerial Visual Servoing Approach
summary: Proposes diffusion-refined visual servoing for precise final-approach UAV navigation from image pairs.
key_takeaways: Relative pose refinement complements global geo-localization

title: PiLoT: Neural Pixel-to-3D Registration for UAV-based Ego and Target Geo-localization
summary: Registers live UAV frames against geo-referenced 3D maps to recover 6-DoF ego pose and geo-locate observed points.
key_takeaways: Map-based absolute pose for GNSS-denied flight
3DGS backends released

title: Game4Loc: A UAV Geo-Localization Benchmark from Game Data
summary: Builds a large synthetic drone-satellite dataset from a video game with partial-match pairs and trains weighted contrastive geo-localization.
key_takeaways: Synthetic data transfers to real benchmarks
Partial-match pairs are more realistic than perfect crops

title: A Transformer-Based Feature Segmentation and Region Alignment Method For UAV-View Geo-Localization
summary: Transformer method that segments and aligns regions between drone and satellite views.
key_takeaways: Widely used University-1652 baseline

title: GNSS/GPS Spoofing and Jamming Identification Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning
summary: Study applying ML and DL to spoofing detection and to jamming-type classification from spectrogram images of public IQ data.
key_takeaways: Spectrogram + CNN reaches 98.93% jamming-type accuracy (ResNet18, transfer learning) on the simulated Swinney-Woods raw IQ dataset (CC BY 4.0)
Code in Colab notebooks

title: Analyzing and Characterizing Multi-Source Interference Effects at Jammertest Norway 2025
summary: Fraunhofer IIS dataset from Jammertest 2025 (Andøya) with a single-antenna E1/E5 receiver and a 2x2 CRPA array, benchmarking 17 ML models for interference type, bandwidth and power, plus YOLOv8s / RF-DETR detection of multiple simultaneous interferers in spectrograms.
key_takeaways: Near-99% within-area classification but large drops across test areas => domain shift is the real problem
Dataset is open on Zenodo (record 21332689) under CC BY-SA 4.0

title: Trends and Challenges in Next-Generation GNSS Interference Management
summary: Magazine paper (submitted to IEEE AESM) on AI for GNSS interference detection, classification, localization and mitigation, with preliminary results and an open dataset from Jammertest 2024 (University of Vaasa VAARA).
key_takeaways: Good map of the field and its datasets

title: Data-Driven Analysis of PNT Resilience: Insights and Lessons from Jammertest 2024 Vehicular Data
summary: Analyses vehicle-mounted GNSS, phone, IMU and camera data collected at Jammertest 2024.
key_takeaways: Shows how consumer and automotive stacks degrade under jamming/spoofing
Data is on GitHub (UniVaasaDigiEco/VAARA) with no licence file => all rights reserved by default; ask before reuse

title: On Your Own: Pro-level Autonomous Drone Racing in Uninstrumented Arenas
summary: Autonomous drone racing using only onboard sensing in arenas without motion capture, with released human pilot flight data.
key_takeaways: Onboard-only state estimation at racing speed
Human pilot data released at github.com/tii-racing/drone-racing-dataset
A2RL is cited as context, not the test venue

title: CVAR-UPM Drone Team - A2RL
summary: Team page describing participation in A2RL seasons 1 and 2 using the open Aerostack2 framework, MPCC control and multi-gate visual positioning.
key_takeaways: A finalist team built on open-source Aerostack2

title: CopterHack 2022
summary: Results page for CopterHack 2022, an open-source drone project competition on the Clover platform; the final was on April 23, 2022 and Atena - Grupo SEMEAR (Swarm in Blocks, 21.6 points) won ahead of FTL (Advanced Clover 2).
key_takeaways: All entries must be open source on Clover
Links to finalist repos

title: Starlink Based LEO PNT (Munich Satellite Navigation Summit 2025)
summary: Lab page pointing to Humphreys' talk at the Munich Satellite Navigation Summit on using Starlink for PNT, with a video link (session 10).
key_takeaways: Status of Starlink as a PNT source
Context for the Starlink PNT service debate

title: A Mock Implementation of Fused LEO GNSS
summary: First experimental demo of fused LEO GNSS with pseudoranges: beam-specific Starlink orbit and clock models are distributed as if by the operator and combined with live Starlink signals, giving 10-meter-level position and timing.
key_takeaways: Concrete design study for LEO PNT

title: Ad Astra: Navigation with Megaconstellation LEO Satellites (IEEE AESS video)
summary: Recorded IEEE AESS Distinguished Lecture on opportunistic navigation with LEO megaconstellation signals.
key_takeaways: Recorded version of the LEO SoOp lecture
Covers tracking unknown LEO signals for nav

title: ION GNSS+ 2025: Galileo at 30 and the Future of Resilient PNT
summary: Report on the ION GNSS+ 2025 plenary (Galileo history keynote) and the conference focus on GNSS vulnerabilities, assured PNT and LEO PNT pathfinders.
key_takeaways: LEO PNT pitched as a third layer
Recording not linked

title: ArduPilot DevCon 2026 (Ottawa) programme
summary: Programme for the October 2026 ArduPilot developer conference, including a live non-GPS Copter demo using a camera and preloaded satellite imagery for absolute positioning.
key_takeaways: ArduPilot is moving toward map-based non-GPS flight
Recordings not linked yet

title: Martin Saska - Onboard relative localization for agile aerial swarming in the wild (RSS 2024 Aerial Swarms workshop slides)
summary: Slides from the RSS 2024 aerial swarms workshop discussing reliable GNSS-denied relative localization for swarms.
key_takeaways: Relative localization (UVDAR) as swarm enabler

title: ERF26 workshop: Innovation and developments in robotic GNSS-denied localisation for inspection and maintenance
summary: European Robotics Forum 2026 workshop on GNSS-denied localization for inspection robots.
key_takeaways: Industrial view of GNSS-denied localization

title: ICRA 2025 workshop: 25 years of aerial robotics - challenges and opportunities
summary: ICRA 2025 workshop covering aerial perception, navigation and planning.
key_takeaways: Broad aerial robotics retrospective
